prompt: Who was the latest woman to pull off a stunning win at the CMA Awards when she was crowned Entertainer of the Year for the second time?
answer: Lainey Wilson. She won CMA Entertainer of the Year in 2023 and again in 2025, becoming only the third woman to win the award twice.
